positions.name: PerspectiveAsRetainedAsset
positions.frame: where does the value of intelligence actually sit — in the substrate that runs it, or in the perspective that owns and keeps it?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same directional move: a plain-spoken antithesis (owned/rented, commodity/asset) that relocates value away from what is borrowed or run and onto what is individually retained. The dimensional reads converge on this locus — register flags both as the same aphoristic-maxim pattern (mint-1), power flags both as the same reclassification-as-persuasion move (mint-1), value flags both as appeals to autonomy/self-possession (mint-1), and relational reads both through market-pricing (asset vs. commodity). Conviction levels both at 'claim' — an unhedged categorical line, not yet ratified as decision or principle — so the group holds a stance being staked, not a settled doctrine. No tension to narrate: src-2 and src-3 build the same contrast from two angles (kind of intelligence; location of asset) rather than opposing each other.
